description: 512-dim: hashed (MD5, 4096 buckets) random Gaussian 64-d embeddings of a token stream (chars tagged last/earlier, function-word tags, per-word char 3/2/4/5-grams, word ids), pooled in 8 blocks with exponential recency decays 0..6, plus current word id, layer-normed with raw position value; truncation at 512 tokens.

512-dim: hashed (MD5, 4096 buckets) random Gaussian 512-d embeddings (64-d slice per block) of a token stream (chars tagged last/earlier, function-word tags, per-word char 3/2/4/5-grams, word ids), pooled in 8 blocks with exponential recency decays 0..6, plus current word id, layer-normed with raw position value; truncation at 512 tokens.
